new_52w_high.name: New 52-week high
new_52w_high.description: Close above every close of the previous 252 sessions.

new_52w_low.name: New 52-week low
new_52w_low.description: Close below every close of the previous 252 sessions.

down_weeks_4.name: 4 straight down weeks
down_weeks_4.description: The week closes lower for the fourth week in a row.

up_weeks_4.name: 4 straight up weeks
up_weeks_4.description: The week closes higher for the fourth week in a row.

big_down_day.name: Fall of 2% or more
big_down_day.description: The index closes 2% or more below the previous close.

big_up_day.name: Rise of 2% or more
big_up_day.description: The index closes 2% or more above the previous close.

gap_down.name: Gap down of 1% or more
gap_down.description: The session opens 1% or more below the previous close.

gap_up.name: Gap up of 1% or more
gap_up.description: The session opens 1% or more above the previous close.

vix_spike.name: India VIX jumps 20%+
vix_spike.description: India VIX closes 20% or more above its previous close.

vix_above_p90.name: India VIX enters its top 10%
vix_above_p90.description: India VIX crosses above its trailing one-year 90th percentile.

correction_10.name: Falls into a 10% correction
correction_10.description: The close first sits 10% or more below its all-time high (after being above that level).

bear_20.name: Falls into a 20% bear market
bear_20.description: The close first sits 20% or more below its all-time high.

budget_day.name: Union Budget day
budget_day.description: The session on which the Union Budget is presented (dates in quantos_platform/analytics/event_calendar.csv).
